checks.detail: Verified on the frozen candidate: all blocking native checks pass (fresh build, session, product-UI separation, embedded assets, source/binary unchanged); anonymous shell and inline email-validation state captured with an attributable, field-associated error; six signed-in surfaces captured with correct headings and active nav; host-run unit suite 28/28 including reset single-use/expiry/rate-limit/enumeration-safe semantics and identifier-derived data dir; cargo fmt --check clean incl. lib.rs:1246 (independently re-run by Tester: exit 0); tsc, vite build, cargo check pass. Visual direction matches the PRD 9 reference boards on every captured surface (calm editorial canvas, restrained accent, icons paired with labels, no prohibited patterns). Fail: PRD-mandated capabilities remain missing — Subtask entity absent and ActivityEvent has schema but no producer (PRD 5), Inbox search/priority/due filters absent and priority has no UI (PRD 6.1), Projects board columns/archive/restore/keyboard drag alternative absent (PRD 6.2), Settings lacks password, sessions, and account-deletion request (PRD 8); PRD 9.2 recovery/responsive states uncaptured; release-critical external journeys (first-run UI path, forgot-reset-sign-in, focusboard:// activation) remain receipt-unproven while the golden path stays an untrusted product self-drive.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.

developer_outcome.summary: Loop-bounded validation performed and passing: reset semantics (single-use, expiry, session invalidation, enumeration-safe responses, rate limiting) under cargo test 28/28; code checks pass (cargo fmt --check incl. lib.rs:1246, cargo check, tsc, vite build, built-config scheme test, probe purity test). Host external lanes remain not_run; receipts stay scheduled for host recapture.

risk_note.summary: The validation most likely to end insufficient_evidence is the host external-drive recapture: both host lanes (external_deeplink probe, external GUI drive) have been not_run for multiple loops, so even readable candidate diagnostics may yield no external receipt this loop.
risk_note.validation: The increment is bounded by unit-testable reset semantics and host-run code checks this loop; external receipts are scheduled as validation recapture and may remain blocked-on-host without invalidating the product work.
risk_note.why_now: Both evidence debts are strategy-exhausted after five consecutive treatment loops, so candidate-side readiness must land now for any future host recapture to be meaningful, and the recovery blocker cannot be deferred without staying the release-critical gap.
